en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a modern mid‑20th‑century hotel building in a snowy landscape. The hotel has four to five stories, a flat roof, and a simple façade with rows of square windows. The word "HOTELL" appears vertically on the left side of the taller block, and on the right block a sign reading "Restaurant" is visible above the ground‑floor level. Deep snow covers the foreground, suggesting a cold northern climate.
